📦 **meadow-telegraph `0290fb9`** — feat(controls): use sail controls for the telegraph on sail-less ships

Route existing W/S and on-screen sail actions through teleStep when a ship
has propulsion but no sails. Preserve one-step taps and delayed hold repeat,
manual telegraph ownership, saved key bindings and normal sail controls on
sailing or mixed-propulsion ships. Cancel held input when switching ships.

Use fixed gear/direction icons and ship-specific tooltips, correct stale
HUD selectors, and document the dual-purpose bindings. Verify real action,
hold, propulsion and HUD functions plus focused dial routing; browser checks
confirm both keyboard and on-screen controls update the circular telegraph.

👥 參與者：@meadow

---
